info.title: Buyer Management
info.description: Management of buyers and their associated details. Provides additional fraud management capabilities around whitelisting and self cure.

post.description:
Allows a user to register a buyer, which may result in creating a new buyer (201 Created) or updating an existing buyer (200 OK), depending on identity matching.

If a new buyer is created:
- Values for name, phone, and email found in the request payload will automatically create a contact and set that contactID as the primaryContactID. The address on this contact will not be populated and must be updated via the appropriate endpoint.
- Status and substatus are both set to "Active".

If an existing buyer is updated:
- See "Update a buyer" for additional details on updating.
- Partial updates are not supported. The user of this API must supply all buyer fields in order to avoid omitted fields being deleted.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); scopes the created buyer to the caller's tenant.
**MerchantID**: Read from token; included in the request context.
**Response scoping**: `reportIIN` and `IIN` are redacted from the response unless the `r:buyer.confidential` scope is present.

schema.description: Represents an error returned by buyer service.

message.description: A simple message in english describing the error and can be returned to the consumer

domain.description: The domain where the error is originating from as defined by the service

metadata.description: Any additional details to be conveyed as determined by the service. If present, will return map of key value pairs

reason.description:
Machine-readable reason code returned in the `reason` field of an error response. Use this value (rather than the human-readable `message`) to programmatically branch on error handling.

| Reason code | Typical HTTP status | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Buyer_Validation` | 400 | The buyer payload failed validation. See `metadata` for the specific field-level errors. |
| `Buyer_Search_Validation` | 400 | The buyer lookup query parameters failed validation (e.g. no search filter supplied, or a verified-only filter used without its corresponding value). |
| `Buyer_Status_Validation` | 400 | The requested buyer status/sub-status combination is invalid or not permitted for the tenant. |
| `Contact_Validation` | 400 | The contact payload failed validation. See `metadata` for the specific field-level errors. |
| `Normalized_Address_Validation` | 400 | The supplied address failed normalization/validation. |
| `Authorized_Third_Party_Validation` | 400 | The authorized third party payload failed validation (e.g. invalid `type`). |
| `Credit_File_Validation` | 400 | The credit file payload failed validation. |
| `Buyer_Phone_Invalid_Type` | 400 | The supplied phone type is not one of the accepted values (`MOBILE`, `WORK`, `HOME`, `OTHER`). |
| `Request_Validation` | 400 | The request could not be parsed or is otherwise malformed. See `metadata` for details. |
| `Identity_Mismatch` | 409 | One or more identity fields on the request do not match the existing buyer that was matched. |
| `Phone_Already_Exists` | 409 | The unverified phone number supplied is already verified on another buyer. |
| `Email_Already_Exists` | 409 | The unverified email address supplied is already verified on another buyer. |
| `Buyer_Conflict` | 409 | The buyer conflicts with an existing buyer and the operation cannot be completed. |
| `Unauthorized` | 401 | The JWT token or path identifiers are not authorized to perform this operation. |
| `Unauthenticated` | 401 | The request is missing valid authentication credentials. |
| `Buyer_Not_Found` | 404 | No buyer was found for the supplied identifier and tenant scope. |
| `Authorized_Third_Parties_Not_Found` | 404 | No authorized third parties were found for the supplied buyer. |
| `Contacts_Not_Found` | 404 | No contacts were found for the supplied buyer. |
| `Bankruptcies_Not_Found` | 404 | No bankruptcy records were found for the supplied buyer. |
| `NormalizedAddressesNotFound` | 404 | No normalized addresses were found for the supplied buyer. |
| `Credit_Files_Not_Found` | 404 | No credit files were found for the supplied buyer. |
| `Credit_Pull_Not_Found` | 404 | No credit pull record was found for the supplied criteria. |
| `CreditReportAttributes_Not_Found` | 404 | No credit report attributes were found for the supplied criteria. |
| `Tenant_Not_Found` | 404 | The tenant associated with the request could not be found. |
| `Buyer_URL_Not_Found` | 404 | The requested URL/route does not exist. |
| `Too_Many_Credit_Pull_Requests` | 429 | The buyer has exceeded the allowed number of credit pull requests. Please wait up to 24 hours before retrying. |
| `Dependency_Response_Invalid` | 500 | A downstream dependency returned a response that could not be processed. |
| `Dependency_Unavailable` | 500 | A required downstream dependency was unavailable or did not respond in a documented way. |
| `Database_Failure` | 500 | An error occurred while performing a database operation. |
| `Encryption_Failure` | 500 | An error occurred while performing an encryption/decryption operation. |
| `CreditReportAttributes_Insert_Failure` | 500 | An error occurred while persisting credit report attributes. |
| `Request_Processing` | 500 | The request could not be processed due to an unexpected server error. |

get.description:
Allows a user to lookup buyers using filtering query parameters.

- A user can lookup by phone and/or email; use `verifiedPhoneOnly` and `verifiedEmailOnly` filters to lookup single buyers with verified contact info.
- At least one of `phone.eq` or `email.eq` filters is required.
- If `verifiedPhoneOnly` or `verifiedEmailOnly` is true, the corresponding `phone.eq` or `email.eq` must also be provided.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Always applied as a filter, scoping results to the caller's tenant.
**BuyerID**: If non-nil in token, callers can only retrieve their own record.
**Response scoping**: `reportIIN` is redacted unless the `r:buyer.confidential` scope is present. If the token role is `buyer`, `IIN` is also redacted.

post.description:
Allows a user to register an unverified buyer, which may result in creating a new buyer (201 Created) or retrieving an existing buyer (200 OK), depending on identity matching.

- The `phoneVerified` and `emailVerified` fields will always be reset to `false` regardless of what was in the request.

If a new buyer is created:
- Values for name, email, and phone found in the request payload will automatically create a contact and set that contactID as the primaryContactID.
- The address on this contact will not be populated and must be updated via the appropriate endpoint.
- Status and substatus are both set to "Active".

If an existing buyer is retrieved:
- Updates to the buyer are not allowed and will not be propagated (e.g., employment details).
- Use any of the PUT endpoints with the returned buyerID to update the buyer.

put.description:
Allows a user to update an existing buyer at a provided buyer ID.

- Users can update IIN if it is not currently set.
- Users can update birthdate if it is not currently set and no credit reports or outstanding loans exist.
- Name, phone, and email updates will propagate to the buyer's primary contact. A new contact will be created in some cases.
- Partial updates are not supported with the exception of IIN. Any existing IIN will not be overwritten with an empty value if omitted.
- All other buyer fields must be supplied to avoid omitted fields being deleted or overwritten with empty values.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); sets the tenant scope for the update operation.
**BuyerID**: If non-nil in token, must exactly match the path `{id}`; a mismatch returns 401.
**MerchantID**: Read from token; included in the request context.
**Response scoping**: If the token role is `service`, all IIN fields are returned regardless of scopes. Otherwise, `reportIIN` and `IIN` are redacted unless the `r:buyer.confidential` scope is present.

post.description:
Allows a user to create a new contact for a given buyer.

- Non-existent buyer IDs will return 404 Not Found.
- Out of scope buyer IDs will return 401 Unauthorized.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); scopes the contact creation to the caller's tenant.
**BuyerID**: Required (non-nil) and must exactly match the path `{id}`; a nil token `buyerID` is rejected. This endpoint is designed for buyer-facing tokens - service accounts should use the SA equivalent.
**MerchantID**: Read from token; included in the request context.

get.description:
Allows a user to get an existing buyer's contact information at the provided buyer ID and contact ID pair.

- Non-existent buyer and contact IDs will return 404 Not Found.
- Out of scope buyer IDs will return 401 Unauthorized.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); scopes the query to the caller's tenant.
**BuyerID**: Required (non-nil) and must exactly match the path `{id}`; a nil token `buyerID` is rejected. This endpoint is designed for buyer-facing tokens - service accounts should use the SA equivalent.

put.description:
Allows a user to update an existing buyer's contact at the provided buyer ID and contact ID pair.

- Updates to a buyer's primary contact name, phone, and email must be done through the update buyer endpoint.
- Non-existent buyer and contact IDs will return 404 Not Found.
- Out of scope buyer IDs will return 401 Unauthorized.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); scopes the update to the caller's tenant.
**BuyerID**: Required (non-nil) and must exactly match the path `{id}`; a nil token `buyerID` is rejected. This endpoint is designed for buyer-facing tokens - service accounts should use the SA equivalent.
**MerchantID**: Read from token; included in the request context.

put.description:
Allows a user to update an existing buyer's status at a provided buyer ID.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Applied as a filter, scoping the update to the caller's tenant.
**BuyerID**: If non-nil in token, must exactly match the path `{id}`; a mismatch returns 401. A nil token `buyerID` passes the check.
**Response scoping**: `reportIIN` is redacted from the response unless the `r:buyer.confidential` scope is present.

get.description:
Allows a user to get an existing buyer's authorized third party information at the provided buyer ID and authorized third party ID pair.

- Non-existent buyer and authorized third party IDs will return 404 Not Found.
- Out of scope buyer IDs will return 401 Unauthorized.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); scopes results to the caller's tenant.
**BuyerID**: If non-nil in token, must exactly match the path `{id}`; a mismatch returns 401. A nil token `buyerID` passes the check.

put.description:
Allows a user to update an existing buyer's authorized third party at the provided buyer ID and authorized third party ID pair.

- Non-existent buyer and authorized third party IDs will return 404 Not Found.
- Out of scope buyer IDs will return 401 Unauthorized.

**JWT Claim Authorization:**
**TenantID**: Required (non-nil); scopes the update to the caller's tenant.
**BuyerID**: If non-nil in token, must exactly match the path `{id}`; a mismatch returns 401. A nil token `buyerID` passes the check.

schema.description:
AuthorizedThirdParty represents a person who is allowed to perform
certain actions on behalf of the buyer

buyerID.description: The ID of the buyer on whose behalf this authorized third party is allowed to act.

consentToCall.description: Whether this authorized third party has consented to receive calls.

consentToEmail.description: Whether this authorized third party has consented to receive emails.

consentToText.description: Whether this authorized third party has consented to receive text messages.

allOf.description: The timestamp value formatted per RFC3339. This does not allow nulls.
Email address

id.description: Unique ID associated with this authorized third party.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this authorized third party is active.

allOf.description: Represents the full name
Telephone number including country code

powerOfAttorney.description: Indicates whether this authorized third party has power of attorney for the associated buyer. Power of attorney legally grants a third party the ability to represent the buyer in private affairs.

attorneyRepresentation.description: Indicates whether this authorized third party is an attorney acting on behalf of the buyer.

type.description:

Possible values: `AUTHORIZED_THIRD_PARTY`, `POWER_OF_ATTORNEY`, `ATTORNEY_REPRESENTATION`, `GUARDIANSHIP`

phoneType.description:
PhoneType represents a phone type as enum
Possible values: `MOBILE`, `WORK`, `HOME`, `OTHER`

updatedAt.description: Time this entity was last updated.

| `Contacts_Not_Found` | 404 | No contacts were found for the supplied buyer. |
